_comment: Mod text per game text language (FUN_006410e0: 0 jp, 1 en, 2 fr, 3 sp, 4 de, 5 it, 9 kr, 10 ch). Game terms from the game's own text (a_ability.bin Sensor, btlend_txt.bin AP). ASCII in jp/kr/ch is written full-width. Regenerate text_strings.h with tools/gen_text.py (outer repo).
